experiment: KSL clean train/test leakage and redundancy audit
split_policy: Any path containing dataset3 is excluded. This follows the public baseline documentation's reported duplicate-leakage concern.

representation.similarity_transform: (T,126) -> linear interpolation to (64,126) -> flatten -> per-sample L2 normalization

interpretation_warning: Exact or near-duplicate evidence is relevant to sample-level split integrity. High cosine similarity alone is not proof of data leakage, signer leakage, or invalid evaluation. Signer identity is not established by this audit.
